label: Rematch — a storm that returns by season
location: The Verdant Ward, the nursery rows

recentEvents.value: The Continuance returned her with the thaw; the saplings he trampled last spring have not forgotten the shape of him. Neither has she.
The Ward's birds now mob the gate-light on sight. The trees taught them.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Grief is a ring. Each visit of his adds one.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask him again to leave in peace. Growth is patient; so is she.
